_note: Relics (docs/plans/rebuild-phase5-run.md, section 8; part 4, section 7): each has a boon and a cost. A "mod" changes every hero's kit (after the loadout); an "enemy_mod" every enemy's; the rest are run rules (RelicDef). Sources: elites, the Shrine, a Rift Tear win (a choice of 2, or neither), the Pedlar now and then, and the Magpie. Numbers are first guesses.
name: Ember Heart
flavor: It still beats, and it still burns.
boon: Every hero's basic attack sets its target Burning.
cost: Every heal your heroes give is 20% weaker.

name: Hollow Crown
boon: Each hero gets a fourth loadout slot.
cost: Each wound takes 20% of max HP, not 15%.

name: Rift-Glass Eye
flavor: Look through it and the rift looks back.
boon: Every fight is Scouted: you see where its enemies stand.

name: Pilgrim's Lantern
flavor: It has walked further than you will.
boon: Rest also steadies the team: 10% more max HP in the next fight.
cost: The Pedlar charges 1 more shard for everything.

name: Bloodstone
flavor: Warm to the touch, and thirsty.
cost: Every hero has 8% less max HP.

name: Gravedigger's Coin
boon: Every won fight pays 2 more shards.

name: Hungry Blade
boon: Every hero's basic attack heals it for a tenth of the damage.
cost: Every hero takes 20% less healing from others.

passives.name: Hungry Blade
passives.text: Heals on the holder are 20% weaker.
